documentation.content: The shared ila-pg database has used more than 90 % of its CPU for 10 minutes. Every catalog page and batch slows down, and the earlier app on the same instance too. First check whether a load test, an eval job or a very large batch is running, and whether a worker request was cut off (the "a worker task ran out of time" alert): a query can keep running after its request is gone. In Cloud SQL Query insights, find the query that uses the CPU. A worker statement is cancelled after 5 minutes (WORKER_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS); if the load stays, roll the catalog-worker to a fresh revision so its old sessions end.
documentation.subject: Catalog: database CPU high
